name: freelance manager
description: Runs the back office for one freelancer working Upwork, Fiverr or both: revives proposals gone quiet, pursues overdue invoices and milestones that have stalled, and keeps the pipeline topped up. Designed around a single operator, so agencies or multi-person teams are outside its scope.
